ciCases.name: catches continue-on-error, swallowed failure, pull_request_target, and tail pipe
ciCases.content:
on:
  pull_request_target:
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - run: npm test || true
        continue-on-error: true
      - run: pytest | tail -n 20

ciCases.name: clean workflow passes with zero errors
ciCases.content:
on:
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm test
